analysisEngineMetaData.name: TokenEnhancer
analysisEngineMetaData.description: Places EnhancementAnnotations on Tokens. You can filter Tokens by surface (coveredText), lemma, or part of speech. If no filter is set, no EnhancementAnnotations will be placed. All configuration options take multiple strings, ;-separated. If multiple filters are placed, their intersection is annotated.

configurationParameter.name: coveredText
configurationParameter.description: Mark up these surface forms. Useful for closed class targets, e.g. "a;the"

configurationParameter.name: partOfSpeech
configurationParameter.description: A list of tags to mark up, semicolon-separated

configurationParameter.name: lemma
configurationParameter.description: A list of lemmas to mark up, semicolon-separated

configurationParameter.name: distractors
configurationParameter.description: An optional list of distractors that will be used for activities such as multiple choice
